title: I Wonder Who's Kissing Her Now — Dean Martin (E♭ major)

details.title: I Wonder Who's Kissing Her Now — Dean Martin
details.lead: The 1909 song by Harold Orlob, Will M. Hough and Frank R. Adams, public domain, as Dean Martin sings it on the live record you sent: written out by ear note by note, his slides and scoops left out, an octave above his voice for the trumpet. One chorus. Lowest note concert B♭3, highest D5.
